global: This shio ramen features a clear, light broth with tender chashu, menma, and naruto fish cake. A single green chili rests atop noodles in a red-rimmed bowl, set on a wooden table beside a glass of water under soft, natural light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with smooth texture and subtle natural wood markings.
regions.bowl: The bowl is ceramic, white with a red rim featuring a distressed, speckled pattern and slightly uneven, textured edge.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is light golden, clear, and glossy, with visible noodles and a single green chili floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows browned, slightly fatty texture with visible marbling and soft, tender surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear translucent, pale yellow, with segmented, slightly curled shapes and glossy, wet surfaces.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: translucent white, smooth, curved, with subtle pinkish hue and glossy surface.
